body.name: cross-fitted bands and separated-model decisions
body.construction: Split \(\mathcal Z_n\) into regression and evaluation folds, estimate every \(\mu_{v,A}\) off-fold, and evaluate squared loss and bounded-kernel HSIC on held-out folds to form simultaneous intervals \(\mathcal B^R_{v,A}\) and \(\mathcal B^H_{v,A,u}\). Intersect each HSIC interval with \(\{0\}\cup[\lambda,\infty)\), recording \(\mathrm{ind}\) when the intersection contains \(0\), \(\mathrm{dep}\) when it meets \([\lambda,\infty)\), both when both are possible, and both when the intersection is empty. Propagate the risk intervals and these decisions through every insertion gain and pruning step; let \(w_S\) be the largest resulting gain half-width and let \(\widehat{\mathcal G}_n\) be the union of all compatible terminal DAGs, with all labelled DAGs returned if that union is empty.
